description: Department of Local Government - (Eastern Province) New Chairman of Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha - A. S. M. Nazeer
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Chairman for the Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
